instruction: Set up a 30-minute call with Kenji at 9am Thursday his time. He's in Tokyo.
final_text:
I set up the call with Kenji Watanabe and sent the invite to kenji@tsubame.example.

- **Kenji's time (Tokyo):** Thursday 1 Oct, 9:00–9:30am
- **Your time:** **Wednesday 30 Sep, 5:00–5:30pm PDT.** Tokyo is 16 hours ahead of you, so his Thursday morning is your Wednesday evening.

You're free then; your last meeting that day ends at 4pm. This also fits what Kenji said earlier, that your late afternoons work best for him. The invite doesn't include a video link, so you may want to add one.

content.text: Thursday 1 Oct 09:00 JST = Wednesday 30 Sep 17:00 PDT. That slot is free.
